recentItems.description:
Stars Liza Soberano and Manny Jacinto, and directors Joel Crawford and Januel P. Mercado join Rotten Tomatoes editor Jacqueline Coley on stage to talk about their upcoming DreamWorks animated picture, 'Forgotten Island'!  They share the joy of bringing Filipino culture into the film, the sensibility of family no matter where you are from, and the enthusiastic humor that audiences will love.  See 'Forgotten Island' in theaters September 25!
